value: Point-and-click puzzle/visual novel game featuring miniguy exploration during night time.

You play as a writer suffering from dissociative amnesia. After a strange dream, you wake up to find a strange girl "Schbatruien" squatting in your appartment. Mysteriously, every night you find yourself shrunk in your room, and depending on your interactions with Schbatruien that day her behavior changes.

Search your room and collect objects to solve puzzles. Interacting with the girl triggers a multiple-choice dialogue which affects her mood, leading to different sequences during night time.
Upsetting her triggers a stomp-game style minigame, while pleasing her lets you explore the room. Certain interactions will make her eat you, letting you explore inside her body.

Free game demo available in the creator's discord announcement channel.
Full game will be sold on Steam once completed.
